frontmatter.name: keel-structured-output
frontmatter.description: Get schema-valid JSON from an open-weight model (DigitalOcean Gradient, Ollama, vLLM, any OpenAI-compatible endpoint) with automatic parse, validate and repair retries. Use when a task needs reliable structured output or tool arguments from a small or open model, or when raw model JSON keeps breaking.
frontmatter.compatibility: Requires Python 3.10+, the keel-harness package, and network access to the Gemini API (GEMINI_API_KEY) or an OpenAI-compatible endpoint (KEEL_API_KEY).

frontmatter.name: keel-plan-change
frontmatter.description: Plan a code change for an issue using a Graphify code graph and an open-weight model, with every cited file and symbol verified against the graph and a ripple report of what else may break. Use when asked how to fix an issue, which files to touch, how risky a change is, or to triage Hacktoberfest "good first issue" tickets in an unfamiliar repository.
frontmatter.compatibility: Requires Python 3.10+, the keel-harness and graphifyy packages, git, and a model key (GEMINI_API_KEY for Gemma 4, or an OpenAI-compatible endpoint).
